title: 名词、冠词、代词
goal: 单复数、可数不可数、a/an/the、人称代词与物主代词

steps.title: 我的朋友们
lines: My friend Tom lives in a big house.
我朋友汤姆住在一栋大房子里。
He has two children and lots of books.
他有两个孩子和很多书。
He is one of my best friends.
他是我最好的朋友之一。
steps.note: two children、lots of books、one of my best friends —— 英语名词要标出“一个还是多个”，这在中文里是不用管的。

steps.title: 名词变复数：规则和例外
what: 一般加 -s：book → books，friend → friends
以 s, x, sh, ch 结尾加 -es：bus → buses，box → boxes，watch → watches
辅音 + y 变 ies：city → cities，family → families（元音 + y 直接加 s：day → days, boy → boys）
f / fe 多变 ves：knife → knives，life → lives，leaf → leaves
不规则：man → men，woman → women，child → children，person → people，foot → feet，tooth → teeth，mouse → mice
why: 大部分规则都是为了“好读”：box 直接加 s 读不出来，就加 -es；不规则复数是古英语留下的，数量不多，背下来就行。
zh: 中文名词不变：“一本书、两本书”，靠数量词和量词表示。英语名词本身要变：a book、two books。
中文的量词（本、个、只）英语一般不需要：两本书 → two books（不说 two pieces of book）。
ex: Their families live in different cities.
他们的家人住在不同的城市。
Some people are waiting for the bus.
steps.sum: 数量 > 1 一定变复数；child → children、person → people 这类不规则成组记。

drill.e: child 的复数是不规则的 children，本身已经是复数，不能再加 s。
辅音 + y 结尾，把 y 变 i 再加 es：cities。
f / fe 结尾的名词多数变 ves：knife → knives，leaf → leaves。

a: He has two children.
He has two kids.

steps.title: one of + 复数：“……之一”
what: one of the / my + 复数名词：从一群里挑一个 —— one of my friends，one of the best books
谓语跟着 one，用单数：One of my friends is a doctor.
why: “之一”的前提是“一群”，所以 of 后面必须是复数；但真正做主语的是 one，所以动词用单数。
zh: 中文“我最好的朋友之一”里“朋友”不变形，于是很多人写成 one of my best friend（漏了 s）。
ex: He is one of my best friends.
他是我最好的朋友之一。
One of the students is from Japan.
学生中有一个来自日本。
This is one of the most important rules.
这是最重要的规则之一。
err: One of the books are mine.
One of the books is mine.
steps.sum: one of + 复数名词 + 单数动词。

drill.q: He is one of my best ___.
drill.e: one of + 复数名词：one of my best friends。“其中之一”一定是从多个里选。

drill.q: One of the students ___ from Japan.
drill.e: one of the students 的主语是 one，所以动词用单数 is，不受 students 影响。

drill.zh: 这是最重要的问题之一。
a: This is one of the most important questions.
This is one of the most important problems.
It's one of the most important questions.
It is one of the most important questions.

steps.text: He is one of my best friends.
steps.zh: 他是我最好的朋友之一。
steps.focus: friends 结尾的 /z/ 要读出来

steps.q: I need a new pair of ___ (shoe).
a: shoes

steps.a: There are lots of people here.
There are lots of people here.

a: I need a new pair of shoes.
I need new shoes.
I need a pair of new shoes.

points: 重点：复数 -s / -es / -ies / -ves，不规则 men, children, people, feet, teeth。
重点：one of + 复数名词，动词用单数。
a pair of 一双；lots of 很多。

steps.title: 买东西
lines: A
How much is this bag?
这个包多少钱？
B
It's fifty dollars.
五十美元。
A
And how many bags do you have in black?
黑色的你们有几个？
B
Let me check. Can I give you some advice? This one is better.
我看一下。给你个建议？这个更好。
steps.note: how much 和 how many，some advice 不是 some advices —— 这一课讲“能不能数”。

steps.title: 不可数名词：information、advice、news 不加 s、不加 a
what: 不可数名词没有复数，前面不能直接加 a 或数字：water, money, information, advice, news, homework, furniture, music, work, luggage
要数它，加“单位”：a glass of water，a piece of advice，two pieces of information
why: 英语把“一团没有明确边界的东西”看作不可数：水、钱（总量）、信息、建议、家具（一类东西的总称）。可数的是能一个一个分开的东西。
zh: 很多词中文能数、英语不能数：“一条信息”“一个建议”“很多作业”“一件家具”。这正是中国学生最常错的地方：<s>an advice</s>、<s>informations</s>、<s>homeworks</s>。
注意 news 虽然以 s 结尾，却是不可数单数：The news is good.
ex: Can you give me some advice?
I have a lot of homework today.
Here's a piece of good news.
err: a piece of advice / some advice
steps.sum: information / advice / news / homework / furniture / money：不加 s，不加 a。

drill.e: information（信息）不可数，不能加 s、不能用 an。book、chair、student 都可数。
advice（建议）不可数：some advice。advise 是动词。要说一条建议用 a piece of advice。
news 虽然以 s 结尾，却是不可数名词，动词用单数 is。

a: I have a lot of homework today.
I have lots of homework today.
I've got a lot of homework today.

steps.title: many / much 与 some / any
what: many + 可数复数：many books；much + 不可数：much money
a lot of / lots of 两者都行，口语最常用
some：肯定句，以及请对方要东西的问句（Would you like some tea?）
any：否定句和一般疑问句（I don't have any money. Do you have any questions?）
why: much 在肯定句里显得生硬，口语肯定句多用 a lot of；much 主要用在否定和疑问：I don't have much time. How much is it?
zh: 中文“很多”“一些”不分可数不可数；英语要先判断名词能不能数，再选词。
ex: How much time do we have?
err: Do you have some questions?（一般询问）
steps.sum: 可数 many、不可数 much；肯定 some、否定疑问 any（请人吃喝用 some）。

drill.e: money 不可数，用 much 修饰。many 和 few 修饰可数名词复数。

drill.q: How ___ students are in your class?
drill.e: students 可数复数，问数量用 How many。How much 问不可数名词的量或价格。
否定句和疑问句里一般用 any：Do you have any questions? some 多用于肯定句或请人吃东西时。

drill.q: Would you like ___ tea? (肯定的邀请)
a: some

s: 一条/一块（修饰不可数名词）

steps.text: Can I give you some advice?

a: How many people are there here?
How many people are here?
How many people are there?

points: 重点：不可数名词（information, advice, news, homework, money）不加 s、不加 a；要数用 a piece of。
重点：many + 可数，much + 不可数；some 肯定 / 请人，any 否定 / 疑问。
How much 问价格和不可数量；How many 问可数数量。

steps.title: 早饭和公交
lines: I have breakfast at seven.
我七点吃早饭。
Then I go to work by bus.
然后坐公交上班。
I waited for an hour at the station.
我在车站等了一个小时。
The bus was late again!
公交又晚点了！
steps.note: have breakfast 和 by bus 前面都没有冠词；an hour 用 an —— 这一课把冠词的几个难点讲透。

steps.title: a 还是 an：看发音，不看字母
what: an 用在元音音素前：an apple, an hour（h 不发音）, an honest man, an MBA（字母 M 读 /em/）
a 用在辅音音素前：a book, a university（u 读 /juː/）, a European, a one-way ticket（/w/）
why: an 的 n 是为了避免两个元音挨着读不顺（a apple → an apple）。所以判断标准是读出来是不是元音开头。
zh: 按字母判断就会错：hour 字母 h 开头却用 an，university 字母 u 开头却用 a。
ex: a university, a uniform, a European city
He is an engineer at a university.
他是一所大学的工程师。
steps.sum: 听开头的音：元音音用 an，辅音音用 a。

drill.e: hour 的 h 不发音，开头是元音音素，用 an：an hour。看读音，不看字母。

drill.q: She studies at ___ university in Tokyo.
drill.e: university 读 /juː-/，开头是辅音音素 /j/，用 a：a university。
honest 的 h 不发音，读音以元音开头，用 an。

steps.title: 不加冠词的场合：三餐、球类、by bus、go to school
what: 三餐：have breakfast / lunch / dinner
球类和棋类：play tennis / football / chess（乐器要加 the：play the piano）
by + 交通工具：by bus, by train, by car（但 in my car, on the bus 要冠词）
go to school / work / bed（去做那件事本身）；at home, at night
语言、学科：study English, like math
why: 这些名词在这里表示的是“活动”本身（吃早饭这件事、上学这件事），不是某个具体的东西，所以不用冠词。一旦说具体的那顿饭、那辆车，就要加：The breakfast at this hotel is great.
zh: 中文本来不用冠词，按理说不容易错，但学了冠词后常常“矫枉过正”：<s>have a breakfast</s>、<s>play the tennis</s>、<s>by the bus</s>。
ex: I go to work by bus.
She plays tennis and plays the piano.
The sun rises in the east.
太阳从东方升起。（独一无二的东西用 the）
steps.sum: 三餐、球类、by + 交通、go to school / bed：不加冠词；乐器、独一无二的东西：加 the。

drill.e: 球类运动前不加冠词：play tennis。乐器前才加 the（play the piano）。
世界上独一无二的东西用 the：the sun、the moon、the earth。

a: by
She goes to work by train every day.
She takes the train to work every day.
Every day she goes to work by train.

s: 坐公交（by 后不加冠词）
x: I go to work by bus.
I go to bed at eleven.

steps.text: I have breakfast at seven and go to work by bus.
steps.zh: 我七点吃早饭，坐公交上班。

steps.a: I waited for an hour at the station.

a: I go to bed at eleven.
I go to bed at 11.
I go to bed at eleven o'clock.

points: a / an：第一次提到；the：双方都知道是哪个、独一无二的东西。
重点：a / an 看发音：an hour、a university。
重点：三餐、球类、by bus、go to school / work / bed 不加冠词；乐器加 the。

steps.title: 自己来
lines: A
Is this pen yours?
这支笔是你的吗？
B
No, it's not mine. I think it's his.
不是我的。我想是他的。
A
Help yourself to some cake!
随便吃点蛋糕！
B
Thanks. Please give me a small piece.
谢谢。请给我一小块。
steps.note: yours、mine、his、yourself、me —— 一个“我”在英语里有五种形式。

steps.title: 主格还是宾格：动词和介词后面用宾格
what: 主格（做主语）：I, you, he, she, it, we, they
宾格（放在动词或介词后面）：me, you, him, her, it, us, them
She likes him. He likes her.
why: 英语靠形式区分“谁做、对谁做”。主格在动词前，宾格在动词或介词后 —— 位置一换，形式就换。
zh: 中文“我”“他”不变形：“我喜欢他 / 他喜欢我”。所以中国学生会说 <s>give I the book</s>、<s>between you and I</s>。
ex: 他昨晚给我们打电话了。
This is for her, not for him.
这是给她的，不是给他的。
Between you and me, it's not good.
err: 主语用主格；礼貌上把 I 放后面
steps.sum: 动词后、介词后：me / him / her / us / them。

drill.e: 动词 give 后面的人用宾格：give me。I 是主格，my、mine 是所有格。
介词 for 后面用宾格：for her。she 是主格，hers 是“她的东西”。

drill.zh: 他昨晚给我们打了电话。
a: He called us last night.
He phoned us last night.
He gave us a call last night.

steps.title: my 还是 mine；its 还是 it's
what: my / your / his / her / its / our / their + 名词：my pen
mine / yours / his / hers / ours / theirs 单独用，后面不接名词：The pen is mine.
its = 它的（没有撇号）；it's = it is / it has
a friend of mine = 我的一个朋友
why: mine 这一组本身就包含了名词（mine = my pen），所以后面不能再接名词。its / it's 是英美人自己也常写错的：撇号代表省略了字母，it's 省略的是 is。
zh: 中文“我的”既能说“我的笔”，也能说“笔是我的”；英语分成两个词。
ex: Is this pen yours? — Yes, it's mine.
steps.sum: my + 名词；mine 单独用；its 它的，it's 它是。

drill.e: 放在句末、后面没有名词时用名词性物主代词：yours = your pen。your 后面必须接名词。
its（它的）没有撇号；it's 是 it is 的缩写。

a: mine

drill.e: by + 反身代词 = 独自、靠自己：by themselves。

steps.text: Is this pen yours? No, it's not mine.
steps.zh: 这笔是你的吗？不是我的。
这本书是她的，不是我的。
a: This book is hers, not mine.
The book is hers, not mine.
This book is hers. It's not mine.

points: 主格 I he she we they；宾格 me him her us them；物主 my / mine；反身 myself。
重点：动词、介词后用宾格：give me, for her。
重点：my + 名词，mine 单独用；its = 它的，it's = it is。

steps.title: 姐姐的鞋
lines: A
Are these your shoes?
这些是你的鞋吗？
B
No, these are my sister's shoes.
不是，这是我姐姐的鞋。
A
And those?
那些呢？
B
Those are my parents' shoes.
那些是我爸妈的鞋。
steps.note: sister's、parents'：所有格的撇号放哪里，听起来一样，写起来不一样。

steps.title: this / these、that / those
body: this（这个）/ these（这些）指近处；that（那个）/ those（那些）指远处。
单复数要和名词一致：this book, these books, that car, those cars。
打电话介绍自己用 this：Hello, this is Mike.（不说 I am Mike）

steps.title: 所有格：'s、s'、of
what: 人和动物：单数加 's：Tom's car，my sister's shoes
以 s 结尾的复数只加 '：my parents' house，the students' books
不以 s 结尾的复数加 's：children's books，women's clothes
物多用 of：the name of the street，the end of the month
why: 撇号位置告诉读者“几个人”：my sister's room（一个姐姐的房间）/ my sisters' room（几个姐姐共用的房间）。口语里两者读音一样，只有写的时候能区分。
zh: 中文“的”什么都能接：“汤姆的车”“街的名字”。英语人用 's，物多用 of —— 说 <s>the street's name</s> 不算错，但 the name of the street 更自然。
ex: My parents' house is near here.
我父母的房子就在附近。
孩子们的玩具到处都是。
What's the name of this street?
err: 以 s 结尾的复数只加撇号
children 不以 s 结尾
steps.sum: 单数 's；s 结尾的复数只加 '；其他复数 's；物多用 of。

drill.e: 以 s 结尾的复数名词，所有格只加撇号：parents' room。parent's 是一个家长的。
不以 s 结尾的复数（children）照常加 's：children's toys。

drill.q: We meet at the end ___ the month.
a: of
This is my sister's car.
It's my sister's car.
That's my sister's car.
This is my older sister's car.

x: at the end of the month

steps.e: 打电话报自己的名字说 This is Anna。I am Anna 用于当面自我介绍。

a: The café is in front of the bank.
The cafe is in front of the bank.

steps.prompt: 用英语写 4–5 句话介绍你的家：家里有几个人、你们各有什么东西（用上 my / mine、's、复数）。
steps.hint: 检查清单：复数加 s 了吗？所有格撇号位置对吗？my 和 mine 用对了吗？
steps.focus: plural nouns, possessives 's / s', my vs mine, countable vs uncountable
steps.model: There are four people in my family. My father has a car, and my mother has a lot of books. My brother's room is small, but mine is big. We have two cats. Their names are Mimi and Coco.

points: this / these 近，that / those 远；打电话说 This is …。
重点：所有格 —— Tom's，parents'，children's；物多用 of。

lessons.title: 单元阅读：A House with a Garden

steps.title: A House with a Garden
steps.note: 先关掉译文读一遍，只用学过的词和本单元的重点。读不懂的句子点 ▶ 听一遍，再打开译文核对。
lines: Anna and her husband have two kids, a boy and a girl.
安娜和丈夫有两个孩子，一男一女。
The family has a new house near the city.
这家人在城市附近有了一栋新房子。
The house is old, but it has a big garden.
房子很旧，但有一个大花园。
The garden is the kids' favorite place.
花园是孩子们最喜欢的地方。
Anna needs some information about schools, so she asks a neighbor for advice.
安娜需要一些关于学校的信息，于是向一位邻居请教。
The neighbor, Mrs. Green, is very kind.
邻居格林太太人很好。
She gives Anna a piece of paper with the names of three schools.
她给了安娜一张纸，上面写着三所学校的名字。
"The school on this street is the best one," she says. "My son goes there by bus."
“这条街上的学校最好，”她说，“我儿子坐公交车去那儿上学。”
In the evening, the family has dinner in the garden.
晚上，一家人在花园里吃晚饭。
The boy loses one of his shoes, and the girl finds it under a tree.
男孩丢了一只鞋，女孩在一棵树下找到了。
"Is this yours?" she asks. "Yes, it's mine!" he says.
“这是你的吗？”她问。“是，是我的！”他说。
It's the end of a long day, and everyone goes to bed early.
漫长的一天结束了，大家都早早上床睡觉。

steps.q: What does the new house have?
steps.e: The house is old, but it has a big garden：有一个大花园。

steps.q: Why does Anna talk to Mrs. Green?
o: She needs a piece of cake.
She wants to buy her house.
steps.e: Anna needs some information about schools：她想了解学校的信息。

steps.q: How does Mrs. Green's son go to school?
steps.e: My son goes there by bus：坐公交车上学。

steps.q: Where does the girl find the shoe?
steps.e: The girl finds it under a tree：在一棵树下找到的。
information 不可数：不加 a，不加 s。

a: She gives Anna a piece of paper.
She gives a piece of paper to Anna.

points: 重点：不可数名词 information、advice、paper（纸）—— 用 some / a piece of。
冠词：a big garden（第一次提到）→ The garden（再提到）；by bus、go to bed 不加冠词。
代词：yours / mine 后面不加名词；the kids' favorite place（复数所有格 s'）。

extra.e: woman 的复数是 women（只改元音），不能再加 s。
information 不可数，不能加 s、不能用 an。
water 不可数，用 How much。
honest 的 h 不发音，读音以元音开头，用 an。

extra.q: We go to school by ___ bus.
extra.e: by + 交通工具时不加冠词：by bus、by car、by train。
放在句末、后面没有名词时用名词性物主代词 hers。her 后面必须接名词。

extra.q: Look at ___ birds in the sky.
extra.e: birds 是复数，指示词也要复数：those（那些）。this / that 是单数，it 不能当限定词。

a: Tom's

extra.a: He is a friend of mine.

bank.q: Please put both ___ under the table.
bank.e: both 指两个，box 以 x 结尾，复数加 es，不能只加 s。

bank.q: Two ___ work here at night.
bank.e: two 后要用复数。man 变 men，不能在两种词形后加 s。

bank.q: We have one long day and two short ___ this week.
bank.e: day 的 y 前是元音字母 a，复数保留 y，只加 s。

bank.q: We need both buses today. One ___ is for the students.
bank.e: 从已提到的两辆车里选一辆，用 of the buses，bus 是单数。

bank.q: One of my friends ___ the night bus every day.
bank.e: 主语中心是 one，习惯动作用 takes。friends 不决定谓语形式。

bank.q: This little tree has only three ___.
bank.e: three 后用复数。把 leaf 末尾的 f 改成 ves，不能直接加 s。

bank.q: This program is for two ___ (family).
a: families
bank.e: two 后要用复数。family 的 y 前是辅音字母 l，要把 y 改成 i 再加 es，不能直接加 s。

bank.q: I can see three ___ (mouse) in the photo.
a: mice
bank.e: three 后要用复数。mouse 的复数是 mice，不能按一般规则写成 mouses。

bank.zh: 这两栋房子里，有一栋离学校很远。
a: One of these two houses is far from the school.
One of the two houses is far from the school.
bank.e: 用 one of 从两栋房子中选一栋。two 后写 houses，谓语跟着 one，写 is。far from 表示离某处远。

a: Both buses are late.
The two buses are both late.
bank.e: bus 以 s 结尾，复数加 es。both 可以放在 buses 前，也可以放在 are 后，谓语仍用 are。

bank.a: I want to read one of your books.
bank.e: 先排出 want to read，再把 one of your books 放在 read 后作宾语。of 后是作为一组的书，所以 books 要用复数。

bank.a: We provide services for lots of people.
bank.e: services 指提供的多种服务，要写复数。lots of 表示许多，people 已是复数，别再加 s。

bank.q: We need ___ for the new house.
bank.e: furniture 是不可数名词，不能加 s，也不能直接用 a 或数字。

bank.q: We need two ___ of information: the time and the place.
bank.e: information 不可数，two 数的是 pieces，复数不用撇号。

bank.q: We can play a game after we do ___.
bank.e: homework 不可数，可以加 our，不能加 s、a 或直接加数字。

bank.q: How ___ games can we play before lunch?
bank.e: games 是可数复数，问数量用 How many。much 问不可数量。

bank.q: There isn't ___ water in this glass.
bank.e: 否定句可用 much 修饰不可数的 water，其余选项修饰可数复数。

bank.q: I have ___ news for you.
bank.e: 肯定句用 some 表示有些，any 常用于否定句。news 不可数。

bank.q: Please bring me two ___ (glass) of water.
a: glasses
bank.e: water 不可数，这里数的是杯子。glass 以 s 结尾，复数加 es，别把复数加在 water 上。

bank.q: There aren't ___ books in this box at all. (Use 'some' or 'any'.)
a: any
bank.e: aren't 和 at all 表示一本书也没有，用 any。some 通常用在肯定句里表示有一些。

bank.zh: 我父亲能给你两条建议。
a: My father can give you two pieces of advice.
My father can give two pieces of advice to you.
bank.e: advice 不可数，给建议计数时用 two pieces of advice。you 可以紧跟 give，或放在句末用 to 引出。

a: How many hours do you work every day?
How many hours a day do you work?
bank.e: 这里问的是几个小时。hour 可数，要用 How many hours，不能用 How much hours。

bank.a: How much money do you need for the bus?
bank.zh: 你坐公交车需要多少钱？
bank.e: money 不可数，把 How much money 整体放在句首，再接 do you need。别把 money 拆到 need 后面。

bank.a: I often listen to music at night.
bank.e: 写出 listen to 里的 to。music 在这里指音乐，不可数，不能写成 musics。

bank.q: Can I have ___ before I go to work?
o: an apple and an glass of water
an apple and a glass of water
a apple and a glass of water
a apple and an glass of water
bank.e: apple 以元音音素开头，用 an。glass 以 /ɡ/ 开头，用 a。

bank.q: You don't need to come back, so buy ___.
bank.e: one-way 以 /w/ 开头，用 a。单数 ticket 需要限定词。

bank.q: You need ___ for this job.
bank.e: MBA 的 M 读 /em/，开头是元音。an 后用单数 MBA。

bank.q: The city is far from here, but we can get there ___ in an hour.
bank.e: 表示交通方式时用 by car，car 前不加冠词。

bank.q: Can you ___? We have time for one game.
bank.e: chess 在这里指棋类活动。play chess 中不加冠词。

bank.q: I can't sleep well ___.
bank.e: at night 是固定搭配，表示在夜里，night 前不加冠词。

bank.q: I need ___ uniform for my new job. (Use 'a' or 'an'.)
a: a
bank.e: uniform 的首字母是 u，开头读的却是辅音 /j/，因此用 a。按首字母写 an 会出错。

bank.q: Do you often have ___ at home or at school? (Use 'lunch', 'a lunch' or 'the lunch'.)
a: lunch
bank.e: 这里问平时在哪里吃午饭，直接说 have lunch。说某一顿特定的午饭时才需要用 the lunch。

bank.zh: 午饭后我们有一个小时。
a: We have an hour after lunch.
We have one hour after lunch.
After lunch, we have an hour.
bank.e: hour 的 h 不发音，因此说 an hour。也可用 one 表示数量。after lunch 说的是用餐时间，lunch 前不加冠词。

a: My father studies English at home.
At home, my father studies English.
bank.e: English 是语言名，前面不加 the。at home 表示在家，home 前也不加冠词。
can 后接动词原形 meet，时间放在后面。after dinner 指吃完晚饭以后，dinner 前不用加冠词。

bank.a: I meet a friend for lunch every week.
bank.e: friend 的开头是辅音 /f/，前面有 a。for lunch 里的 lunch 是餐名，直接写。

bank.q: My father is at the station now. We can meet ___ there.
bank.e: 见面对象作 meet 的宾语，用 him。he 是主格，his 表所属。

bank.q: Can our teacher come with you and ___?
bank.e: you 和 me 都跟在介词 with 后。这里用宾格 me，不能用主格 I。

bank.q: ___ want to learn more about this city.
bank.e: want 前缺主语，用 We。Us 是宾格，We're 会多出一个 are。

bank.q: I know where my books are. Do you know where ___ are?
bank.e: yours 指你的书。your 要接名词，you're 已含 are。

bank.q: This company provides a good service, but I don't know ___ name.
bank.e: its name 指这家公司的名字。it's 含有动词，不能用来修饰名词。

bank.q: We can meet in ___ room. It is big.
bank.e: room 前需要 our 表所属。ours 单独用，we 和 us 不表所属。

bank.q: We need help. Can you show ___ (we) the way?
a: us
bank.e: show 后面先接接受帮助的人，再接 the way。这里的人是动作的对象，所以 we 要变成 us。

bank.q: The big room is our room. The small room is ___ (they).
a: theirs
bank.e: 空后没有名词，用 theirs 代替 their room。their 后要接名词，them 只作宾格。

bank.zh: 她可以和我一起去学校。
a: She can go to school with me.
She can go with me to school.
bank.e: 句首的她是主语，用 She。跟在介词 with 后的我要用宾格 me，不能写 with I。

bank.zh: 我的一个朋友在这家公司工作。
a: A friend of mine works at this company.
One of my friends works for this company.
bank.e: a friend of 后用 mine，不能用 my。也可说 one of my friends，这时 my 后接复数名词。
一般疑问句先用 Do you know，再接宾语 their names。their 修饰 names，不能把两词倒过来。

bank.a: I can do the work by myself.
bank.e: by myself 表示独自完成，和主语 I 对应。不要写成 by me，也别把 myself 拆开。

bank.q: I have two maps here. Can we use ___ maps to find the city?
bank.e: here 指身边，maps 是复数，选 these。those 指较远处。

bank.q: Can you see ___ car over there?
bank.e: over there 指远处，car 是单数，用 that。this 指近处。

bank.q: We have one dog. ___ name is Max.
bank.e: 只有一只狗，dog 后加 's。dogs' 是复数所有格。

bank.q: All four ___ books are on this table.
bank.e: four 对应复数 students。词尾已有 s，表示所属时只加撇号。

bank.q: Two women are here for their bags. Please put both ___ bags in the car.
bank.e: 两位女士用 women。词尾没有 s，所有格加 's。

bank.q: I need the books over there. Can you bring ___ to me?
bank.e: 远处的几本书用 those 指代。these 指近处，that 是单数。

bank.q: Look at ___ photo in my hand. (Use 'this', 'that', 'these' or 'those'.)
a: this
bank.e: 照片在说话人手里，而且只有一张，用近处单数 this。these 指多张，that 指较远处。

bank.q: The front ___ the car is black, but the back is white.
a: of
bank.e: the front of the car 表示汽车的前部。把部位放在 of 前，整体放在 of 后。from 表示来源，放在这里不能表达所属。

a: Do you want to use this pen?
Would you like to use this pen?
bank.e: 用 this 指近处的一支笔。those 指远处的多个物品，these 也得和复数名词搭配。

a: Those books are the children's.
Those are the children's books.
bank.e: those 指远处的多本书。children 已是复数，词尾没有 s，所有格要加 's，不能写成 childrens'。

bank.a: I like the end of this story.
bank.zh: 我喜欢这个故事的结尾。
bank.e: 先排 I like，再接喜欢的事物 the end of this story。the end 在 of 前，this story 在 of 后，顺序不能颠倒。

bank.a: Both teams' names are on the board.
bank.e: both 指两支队，teams 是复数。撇号放在 s 后面，teams' names 表示两支队各自的名字。
